summary: Created configurable development-flow catalog schema covering default flow selection, work-item bindings, ordered role steps, command templates, lifecycle hooks, proof gates, host-agent adapter projection, and future approval gates.

Made the master template and schema the option authority, required complete typed fail-closed lane projections, separated team/profile authority from selected model profile, and added deterministic packs/commands-aware identities.

Required one explicit dispatch alias per executable node, exact-one field and registry authority, context-specific architect routing, distinct carrier/backend relations, and complete authority/execution identity refs.

Defined strict three-field carrier and five-field executor-backend relations, persisted schema-complete all-flow payload hashing, two-phase identity without circular references, reload/migration blockers, and 13-flow/51-lane example coverage.
Clarified host-system backend_id inputs as source DSL and scoped loose-backend rejection to resolved lanes and runtime assignments.
